compendium_title: 45 Core Sayings and Edicts of Ala Hazrat Imam Ahmad Raza Khan
compiler_framework: Fatawa Razawiyya and Wasaaya Shareef Extract

namaz_and_ibadah.topic: The Worth of Deeds Without Namaz
namaz_and_ibadah.saying: If a person does not pray Namaz, all their other voluntary good deeds and charity hold no real spiritual luster.
namaz_and_ibadah.core_lesson: Obligatory prayers (Fard) are the bedrock of all accepted worship.

namaz_and_ibadah.saying: While praying, imagine you are standing directly before the Master of universes, and keep your gaze strictly on the place of prostration.
To leave the congregational prayer (Jama'at) without a valid Islamic legal excuse is a severe deprivation of immense rewards.
namaz_and_ibadah.core_lesson: Community prayer holds 27 times more spiritual merit.

namaz_and_ibadah.saying: Fulfilling your missed lifelong obligatory prayers (Qada) must take absolute priority over reciting voluntary Nafl prayers.
namaz_and_ibadah.core_lesson: Debts of Allah must be paid before presenting voluntary gifts.

namaz_and_ibadah.saying: Delaying Namaz deliberately until its designated time is almost over is an act that invites the displeasure of the Almighty.
namaz_and_ibadah.core_lesson: Perform every prayer strictly within its preferred (Mustahabb) window.

namaz_and_ibadah.saying: Your heart must be fully present when making the intention for Namaz; verbal utterances are merely a support for the mind.
namaz_and_ibadah.core_lesson: The place of intention is fundamentally inside the heart.

namaz_and_ibadah.saying: A mosque is a house of Allah; talking about mundane worldly businesses or gossiping inside it burns away good deeds like fire burns wood.
namaz_and_ibadah.core_lesson: Maintain the highest standards of etiquette inside sacred spaces.

namaz_and_ibadah.saying: Perform your ablution with absolute care, ensuring not a single hair-breadth of space remains dry, for a flawless Wudu is the key to Namaz.
namaz_and_ibadah.core_lesson: Physical purification directly impacts internal spiritual readiness.

namaz_and_ibadah.saying: The Friday prayer is a profound blessing for the Ummah; missing it intentionally hardens the heart and creates spiritual negligence.
namaz_and_ibadah.core_lesson: Jummah is a foundational weekly pillar of Islamic unity.

namaz_and_ibadah.saying: For a woman, performing her daily prayers within the safety and privacy of her home brings greater spiritual reward than attending public congregations.
namaz_and_ibadah.core_lesson: Modesty and privacy enhance the internal value of female devotion.

namaz_and_ibadah.saying: A servant is closest to their Creator during the state of Sajdah; pour your soul out in humility during this moment.
namaz_and_ibadah.core_lesson: Sajdah represents the ultimate peak of human humility.

holy_quran_reverence.saying: Never touch the physical text of the Holy Quran without a complete state of ritual purity (Wudu), as the Quran demands the highest form of respect.
holy_quran_reverence.core_lesson: Absolute purity is non-negotiable for touching holy script.

holy_quran_reverence.saying: When the Divine Words are being recited out loud in a dedicated gathering, it is individually binding upon everyone present to remain silent and listen.
holy_quran_reverence.core_lesson: Listening to the Quran with focus is a direct source of mercy.

holy_quran_reverence.saying: Beautify your recitation by learning correct Tajweed, because mispronouncing letters so badly that it changes the meaning can ruin the validity of your Namaz.
holy_quran_reverence.core_lesson: Accurate phonetic execution of Arabic letters is mandatory.

holy_quran_reverence.saying: Do not let a single day pass without opening the Book of Allah, even if it is only to recite a few verses with translation.
holy_quran_reverence.core_lesson: Consistency in recitation illuminates the household.

holy_quran_reverence.saying: Reading the Quran is a source of reward, but the true objective is to shape your daily character according to its commands and prohibitions.
holy_quran_reverence.core_lesson: Knowledge without practical application holds no spiritual weight.

holy_quran_reverence.saying: Never place any other book, object, or keys on top of the Holy Quran; it must always occupy the highest physical position on a shelf.
holy_quran_reverence.core_lesson: Physical etiquette reflects deep internal reverence.

holy_quran_reverence.saying: The Holy Quran is a literal cure (Shifa) for both spiritual diseases of the heart and physical illnesses of the body.
holy_quran_reverence.core_lesson: Utilize specific Surahs like Al-Fatiha for divine healing.

holy_quran_reverence.saying: Adorn the text with a sincere, melodious tone, but avoid singing styles that distort the rules of traditional Arabic grammar.
holy_quran_reverence.core_lesson: Melody should serve the text, not distort its phonetic rules.

holy_quran_reverence.saying: A heart that does not contain any part or verses of the Holy Quran is like a ruined, desolate house.
holy_quran_reverence.core_lesson: Commit key chapters to memory to keep the heart lively.

holy_quran_reverence.saying: A true Hafiz of the Quran who protects its laws and boundaries will be an intercessor for his family on the Day of Judgment.
holy_quran_reverence.core_lesson: Preserving the text in the mind requires lifelong responsibility.

holy_quran_reverence.saying: Do not interpret the profound meanings of the Quran using your own flawed intellect without consulting classical scholars and Tafsir.
holy_quran_reverence.core_lesson: Self-styled interpretation without academic grounding leads to misguidance.

urs_and_isal_e_sawab.saying: The true meaning of Urs is to gather for the recitation of the Quran, feed the poor, and send spiritual rewards to the souls of the pious Awliya.
urs_and_isal_e_sawab.core_lesson: Commemoration must be centered purely around lawful worship.

urs_and_isal_e_sawab.saying: To perform prostration (Sajdah) to a grave out of reverence is strictly forbidden (Haram), and doing it with an intention of worship is absolute Kufr.
urs_and_isal_e_sawab.core_lesson: Sajdah belongs exclusively to Allah Almighty.

urs_and_isal_e_sawab.saying: Gatherings where men and women mix freely without valid Islamic partitions or where un-Islamic innovations take place lose all spiritual blessings.
urs_and_isal_e_sawab.core_lesson: Modesty must be maintained at religious shrines.

urs_and_isal_e_sawab.saying: When visiting the resting places of the Awliya, stand at a respectful distance, recite Isal-e-Sawab, and use their spiritual station as a means to ask Allah.
urs_and_isal_e_sawab.core_lesson: Shrines are places to remember death and seek divine mercy.

urs_and_isal_e_sawab.saying: The deceased in their graves eagerly await the gifts of prayer, Istighfar, and charity sent to them by their living family members.
urs_and_isal_e_sawab.core_lesson: Isal-e-Sawab bridges the living world with the realm of souls.

urs_and_isal_e_sawab.saying: Placing fresh green flowers on graves is recommended, because as long as they stay fresh, they perform Tasbih, which brings comfort to the soul.
urs_and_isal_e_sawab.core_lesson: Nature's glorification of Allah acts as a source of mercy.

urs_and_isal_e_sawab.saying: Reciting the Holy Quran or religious hymns for the deceased must be done out of pure love, never for commercial or financial negotiation.
urs_and_isal_e_sawab.core_lesson: Spiritual reward cannot be bought or sold for worldly wages.

urs_and_isal_e_sawab.saying: Patience during a bereavement is heavily rewarded, whereas loud wailing and tearing of clothes causes distress to the departed soul.
urs_and_isal_e_sawab.core_lesson: Submit to the divine decree with dignity and prayer.

urs_and_isal_e_sawab.saying: Even giving a single glass of water to a thirsty person with the intention of sending reward to your deceased parents reaches them instantly.
urs_and_isal_e_sawab.core_lesson: Small acts of charity carry immense weight when gifted to ancestors.

urs_and_isal_e_sawab.saying: Do not walk over, step on, or sit carelessly upon any grave, for the sanctity of a Muslim remains intact even after their death.
urs_and_isal_e_sawab.core_lesson: Respect for the dead mirrors respect for the living.

urs_and_isal_e_sawab.saying: Staying connected to your spiritual guide (Pir) and attending the annual Urs of their lineage keeps your faith anchored against modern trials.
urs_and_isal_e_sawab.core_lesson: Spiritual companionship preserves long-term religious values.

good_deeds_and_character.saying: The absolute foundation of all good deeds is deep, unyielding love and reverence for the Holy Prophet Muhammad.
good_deeds_and_character.core_lesson: Deeds void of prophetic devotion carry no weight in Islam.

good_deeds_and_character.saying: Looking at the faces of your parents with love and devotion yields the spiritual reward of an accepted voluntary Hajj.
good_deeds_and_character.core_lesson: Filial piety is a fast track to gaining the pleasure of Allah.

good_deeds_and_character.saying: Do not allow mutual worldly disagreements to breed long-lasting hatred or malice against another Muslim brother.
good_deeds_and_character.core_lesson: A clean heart is a prerequisite for accepted prayers.

good_deeds_and_character.saying: Earning a lawful livelihood (Halal Rizq) through honest trade is an obligation that follows right after the primary obligations of worship.
good_deeds_and_character.core_lesson: Economic integrity protects the acceptance of internal worship.

good_deeds_and_character.saying: The sacred Shariah is the root, and the Sufi path (Tariqah) is its branch. Anyone trying to bypass the root will find their branch withered.
good_deeds_and_character.core_lesson: Mystical insight cannot exist outside the boundaries of Islamic law.

good_deeds_and_character.saying: To disrespect or mock an authentic, practicing Islamic scholar due to their knowledge is a sign of underlying hypocrisy.
good_deeds_and_character.core_lesson: Scholars are the inheritors of prophetic knowledge.

good_deeds_and_character.saying: Backbiting and speaking ill behind someone's back destroys your own stock of good deeds faster than physical sins.
good_deeds_and_character.core_lesson: Protect your spiritual wealth by controlling your speech.

good_deeds_and_character.saying: To feed a hungry human being or animal out of pure mercy is an act that can easily draw down the overarching forgiveness of Allah.
good_deeds_and_character.core_lesson: Compassion to creation is a marker of genuine faith.

good_deeds_and_character.saying: An ounce of true humility inside your character is far superior to mountains of worship ruined by pride and self-righteousness.
good_deeds_and_character.core_lesson: Arrogance blocks the pathways of divine enlightenment.

good_deeds_and_character.saying: The most beloved good deed in the court of Heaven is that which is performed regularly, even if it is small in appearance.
good_deeds_and_character.core_lesson: Habitual virtue builds resilient spiritual character.

good_deeds_and_character.saying: Hold fast to the consensus of the mainstream righteous majority (Ahle Sunnat), and do not be swayed by fleeting modern innovations.
good_deeds_and_character.core_lesson: The community consensus protects individuals from straying.

good_deeds_and_character.saying: Live your life in this world like a passing traveler, ensuring your bags are packed with prayers, repentance, and sincere intentions.
good_deeds_and_character.core_lesson: Remembrance of the afterlife filters out worldly greed.
